<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/api/v1/disputes/{dispute_id}/close"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Close the dispute by accepting the provider's outcome. Used when
the merchant chooses not to contest (or to stop contesting). Once
closed the dispute state is terminal — subsequent evidence uploads
are no-ops. For the final funds-movement state, listen for the
`payment.dispute.funds_withdrawn` or
`payment.dispute.funds_reinstated` webhook event.
